Der Ursprung ist oft eine Mischung aus Entzündung und übererregten Nerven. Genau hier setzt die Kältekammer an. Der Kältereiz drosselt Entzündungsstoffe und beruhigt die Schmerzweiterleitung. deals.metaGraphCaption: Date night in Vienna! We went to The Prater, an amusement park that has a history dating back to the 16th century. It was first opened as a recreational space, literally meadows and a hunting ground and initially was restricted to use by the nobility. In the 1600’s the Prater was opened to all. Over the years it evolved with the opening of inns and restaurants and eventually 'amusements’. There are so many things to love about The Prater - first of all, there is no fee to enter! If you’d just like to go for a stroll, you can enjoy the energy and the sights for free. And you can bring your dog 😊. We took a ride on 'The Riesenrad‘, it was first opened in 1897. in its first year it hosted more than 200,000 passengers. It was damaged in WWII, but restored and is still privately owned. After enjoying the world‘s oldest Ferris wheel, we had a pork hock dinner and a mug of Budweiser 🍺 #vienna #prater #schreiberhausvienna #riesenrad
